name: Engagement letter: bookkeeping and accounting services

blocks.text: {Firm name} (“firm,” “we,” “us,” or “our”) is pleased to provide {Client name} (“you” or “your”) with the bookkeeping and accounting services described below for {Agreement year}. Please read this letter, the Terms and Conditions below and any other attachments incorporated herein (collectively, “Agreement”). This Agreement details the nature and limitations of the services we will provide, the terms of our engagement and each party’s responsibilities.
We will provide the following services each month, from the records and information you provide:

items: recording your transactions in your accounting software from your bank, credit card and other statements and the documents you provide;
reconciling the bank and credit card accounts you name to their statements;
proposing adjusting entries for your review and approval; and
preparing a monthly balance sheet and income statement from your general ledger for your internal use.

blocks.text: These services are non-attest services. We will not audit, review or compile your financial statements, and we will not express an opinion, a conclusion or any form of assurance on them. The monthly reports are prepared for your management’s internal use only and are not intended for third parties, such as lenders or investors. If you need financial statements for a third party, we will agree to that in a separate written agreement.

Our engagement does not include any procedures designed to detect errors, fraud, theft, or other wrongdoing, and cannot be relied upon to disclose such matters. We will tell you of any such matters that come to our attention.

We will perform our services with the care a reasonable accountant would exercise in this type of engagement, under the AICPA Code of Professional Conduct. We will not make management decisions or perform management functions on your behalf, sign checks, initiate or approve payments, or hold custody of your assets.

You are responsible for the accuracy and completeness of your records and the information you provide; for making all management decisions and performing all management functions; for designating a person with suitable skill, knowledge and experience to oversee our services; for evaluating the adequacy and results of our services and accepting responsibility for them; and for establishing and maintaining internal controls. Please provide your statements and documents by the 10th of the following month so that we can complete each month’s work.
Our fees for the services in this Agreement are:

A monthly fee is charged each month to the payment method you set up on our client portal, until this Agreement ends. Work outside the scope of this Agreement, such as clean-up of prior periods or records received late, is billed separately at our standard rates after we tell you of it.

This Agreement covers the services for {Agreement year} and continues month to month after that until replaced by a new agreement or ended by either party in writing, as the Terms and Conditions describe.

We appreciate the opportunity to be of service to you. This Agreement, including the Terms and Conditions, represents the entire agreement of the parties relating to the services that are the subject of this Agreement. Please sign below to accept it.
